note: Fossil-revival index for PUWFossilRevivalService. Single-fossil mappings are copied from the held item registry (data/items_full_compact.json, PokeAPI-derived effect_full text, verbatim species + service wording). Per-version separation: each record names the generation whose service introduced the fossil; revival level is that debut service's level (level_basis). No held gift-level table exists in the registry (checked data_registry/converted + veekun CSVs 2026-11-23), so levels are the series' documented revival convention for the debut game, stored per record so a sourced gift-data pass can rescale by data swap alone. Galar component fossils carry NO species in the held registry (effect text is null there); their pair combinations are the canonical Sword/Shield restoration pairings, labeled as such in each record's source field.
